title: 3 Styles Hollow Cutout Wooden Funeral Guest Book In Loving Memory Spiral Binding Memorial Sign In Book Remembrance Keepsake For Celebration Of Life Service
body_html:
3 Elegant Hollow Cutout Cover Styles Available
This memorial guest book offers three classic cover designs: cross hollow, heart hollow and MEMORY hollow cutout, all engraved with delicate golden cursive "In Loving Memory". The hollow window design adds a solemn, warm and touching touch for funeral, celebration of life and remembrance services.
Premium Dark Stained Solid Wooden Hard Cover
Crafted from high-quality natural wood with dark matte staining, the cover features smooth polished edges and clear laser engraving. Sturdy, scratch-resistant and long-lasting, far more durable than ordinary paper funeral guest books to preserve precious signatures for years.
Practical Metal Double Loop Spiral Binding
Adopts thick metal double ring spiral binding, allowing the book to lay completely flat when writing. Pages won’t curl or fall out easily, bringing guests a smooth signing experience without struggling to hold the book open during memorial events.
Sentimental Keepsake for Funeral & Remembrance Occasions
Perfect as a funeral guest register, memorial signature book, celebration of life memory journal or bereavement gift. It lets family collect heartfelt messages, signatures and warm memories from attendees to honor lost loved ones and keep precious condolences forever.


Package Includes: 2 pieces of covers + 250g kraft paper (20/30/40 sheets) + 2 key rings.
Product Weight (20 black card pages): 430g after packaging for B5 size
B5 Product Dimensions: 27×19×1.2 CM
B5 Package Dimensions: 21.5×3.5×29 CM
B5 Carton Dimensions: 46×31×45 CM, 24 sets per carton

Classic Minimalist Design for Wide Occasions
Understated dark wood tone matches all kinds of memorial venue styles, including church funeral, family remembrance gathering and religious memorial service. Compact portable size is easy to carry and place on memorial tables for guests to sign freely.
